#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

const int INF = (int)1e8;

struct Node {
    Node* left;
    Node* right;
    int batchSetValue;
    bool dirty;
    int min_val;

    Node() : left(nullptr), right(nullptr), batchSetValue(0), dirty(false), min_val(INF) {}
};

void setValue(int f, int t, int l, int r, int val, Node* node) {
    if (f > r || t < l) {
        return;
    }
    if (f <= l && t >= r) {
        node->min_val = val;
        node->batchSetValue = val;
        node->dirty = true;
        return;
    }

    node->pushDown();
    int m = (l + r) >> 1;
    setValue(f, t, l, m, val, node->left);
    setValue(f, t, m + 1, r, val, node->right);

    node->pushUp();
}

Node* build(int l, int r) {
    Node* node = new Node();
    if (l != r) {
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        node->left = build(l, m);
        node->right = build(m + 1, r);
    }
    return node;
}

int query(int f, int t, int l, int r, Node* node) {
    if (f > r || t < l) {
        return INF;
    }
    if (f <= l && r <= t) {
        return node->min_val;
    }
    node->pushDown();
    int m = (l + r) >> 1;
    return min(query(f, t, l, m, node->left), query(f, t, m + 1, r, node->right));
}

void update(int i, int l, int r, int val, Node* node) {
    if (i > r || i < l) {
        return;
    }
    if (i <= l && i >= r) {
        node->min_val = min(node->min_val, val);
        return;
    }

    node->pushDown();
    int m = (l + r) >> 1;
    update(i, l, m, val, node->left);
    update(i, m + 1, r, val, node->right);

    node->pushUp();
}

void toArray(int l, int r, vector<int>& data, Node* node) {
    if (l == r) {
        data[l] = node->min_val;
        return;
    }
    node->pushDown();
    int m = (l + r) >> 1;
    toArray(l, m, data, node->left);
    toArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
}

void fromArray(int l, int r, vector<int>& data, Node* node) {
    if (l == r) {
        node->min_val = data[l];
        return;
    }

    node->dirty = false;
    int m = (l + r) >> 1;
    fromArray(l, m, data, node->left);
    fromArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
    node->pushUp();
}

void Node::pushUp() {
    this->min_val = min(this->left->min_val, this->right->min_val);
}

void Node::setValue(int val) {
    this->min_val = val;
    this->batchSetValue = val;
    this->dirty = true;
}

void Node::pushDown() {
    if (this->dirty) {
        this->left->setValue(this->batchSetValue);
        this->right->setValue(this->batchSetValue);
        this->dirty = false;
    }
}

class BlockReader {
public:
    static const int EOF = -1;
    istream* is;
    char* dBuf;
    int dPos, dSize, next;
    string builder;

    BlockReader(istream& is) : is(&is), dPos(0), dSize(0), next(0) {
        dBuf = new char[4096];
        next = nextByte();
    }

    ~BlockReader() {
        delete[] dBuf;
    }

    int nextByte() {
        while (dPos >= dSize) {
            if (dSize == -1) {
                return EOF;
            }
            dPos = 0;
            is->read(dBuf, 4096);
            dSize = is->gcount();
            if (dSize == 0) {
                return EOF;
            }
        }
        return (unsigned char)dBuf[dPos++];
    }

    void skipBlank() {
        while (next != EOF && isspace(next)) {
            next = nextByte();
        }
    }

    int nextInteger() {
        skipBlank();
        int ret = 0;
        bool rev = false;
        if (next == '+' || next == '-') {
            rev = next == '-';
            next = nextByte();
        }
        while (next >= '0' && next <= '9') {
            ret = (ret << 3) + (ret << 1) + next - '0';
            next = nextByte();
        }
        return rev ? -ret : ret;
    }

    bool hasMore() {
        skipBlank();
        return next != EOF;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    BlockReader input(cin);

    int n = input.nextInteger();
    int k = input.nextInteger();

    vector<vector<int>> intervals(k + 2, vector<int>(2, 0));
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        intervals[i][0] = input.nextInteger();
        intervals[i][1] = input.nextInteger();
    }
    intervals[k + 1][0] = 2 * n;
    intervals[k + 1][1] = 2 * n;

    k++;

    vector<Node*> loop(2);
    loop[0] = build(0, n);
    loop[1] = build(0, n);

    vector<int> data(n + 1, INF);

    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        Node* curDp = loop[i & 1];
        Node* lastDp = loop[(i - 1) & 1];

        vector<int> interval = intervals[i];
        int intervalLength = interval[1] - interval[0];
        int middleLength = interval[0] - intervals[i - 1][1];

        toArray(0, n, data, lastDp);
        if (intervalLength + middleLength <= n) {
            for (int j = n; j >= intervalLength + middleLength; j--) {
                data[j] = data[j - (intervalLength + middleLength)];
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < intervalLength + middleLength && j <= n; j++) {
                data[j] = INF;
            }
        } else {
            fill(data.begin(), data.end(), INF);
        }

        int minX = interval[1] - middleLength - intervalLength;
        int maxX = interval[1] - middleLength;
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int minNeedTime = query(max(0, minX - j), min(n, maxX - j), 0, n, lastDp);
            data[j] = min(data[j], minNeedTime + 1);
        }

        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int leftBound = j - middleLength - intervalLength;
            int rightBound = j - middleLength;
            int minNeedTime = query(max(0, leftBound), min(n, rightBound), 0, n, lastDp);
            data[j] = min(data[j], minNeedTime + 2);
        }

        fromArray(0, n, data, curDp);
    }

    int minFlipTime = query(n, n, 0, n, loop[k & 1]);

    if (minFlipTime < INF) {
        cout << "Full" << endl;
        cout << minFlipTime << endl;
    } else {
        cout << "Hungry" << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
